description.content:
Get track recommendations based on a seed track. Parameters: ---------- seed_track_id : str (Spotify ID of the reference track)
limit : int, default=20 (Number of recommendations, max 100)
min_popularity : int, optional (Minimum popularity score 0-100)
genre_match : bool, default=False (Prioritize same genre)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackIDList
List of recommended track IDs
Notes: ----- Uses audio features to find tracks with similar characteristics.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Get track recommendations matching specific audio features. Parameters: ---------- features : TargetFeatures (Target audio characteristics)
- tempo: float, optional (Target BPM, 0-300)
- energy: float, optional (Target energy level, 0-1)
- danceability: float, optional (Target danceability, 0-1)
- duration_ms: int, optional (Target duration in ms, 30000-900000)
- other audio features...
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackIDList
List of matching track IDs
Notes: ----- Finds tracks that best match the specified audio characteristics.

Get tracks that are musically compatible with a reference track. Parameters: ---------- params : CompatibleParams
- track_id: str (Reference track ID)
- compatibility_type: str, default="both" (key, bpm, both)
- limit: int, default=20 (Number of recommendations)
- min_popularity: int, optional (Minimum popularity score)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackIDList
List of tracks compatible with the reference track
Notes: ----- Useful for DJ mixing, creating smooth transitions, or harmonic playlists.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Get tracks with characteristics contrasting to a reference track. Parameters: ---------- params : ContrastParams
- track_id: str (Reference track ID)
- contrast_features: List[str], default=["energy", "valence"] (Features to contrast)
- limit: int, default=20 (Number of recommendations)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackIDList
List of tracks with contrasting characteristics
Notes: ----- Creates variety in playlists by finding tracks with opposite characteristics.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Get track recommendations suitable for a specific time of day. Parameters: ---------- params : TimeOfDayParams
- time: str (One of: morning, afternoon, evening, night)
- genre: str, optional (Specific genre filter)
- limit: int, default=20 (Number of recommendations)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackIDList
List of recommended track IDs suitable for the time of day
Notes: ----- Different times of day have different energy/mood profiles.

Get recommendations for tracks with specific beat structure characteristics. Parameters: ---------- params : BeatStructureParams
- min_regularity: float, default=0.7 (Minimum beat regularity score 0-1)
- tempo_min: float, optional (Minimum tempo in BPM)
- tempo_max: float, optional (Maximum tempo in BPM)
- genre: str, optional (Specific genre filter)
- limit: int, default=20 (Number of recommendations)
x_api_key : str (API key for authentication)
Returns: ------- TrackIDList
List of recommended track IDs matching beat structure criteria
Notes: ----- Useful for finding tracks with consistent, predictable beat patterns.

API for accessing music track audio analysis, features (tempo, key, mode, energy, danceability, valence, instrumentalness, acousticness, loudness), search, and recommendations. SoundStat is an independent audio-analysis alternative to the deprecated Spotify audio-features endpoints.
